label: Updated at 8 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Scheffler Dominates FedEx Cup
items.text: Scottie Scheffler earned his second PGA Tour win of the season and now ranks 21st all-time with 21 PGA Tour leads, trailing only Tiger Woods and Jack Nicklaus.

items.headline: LIV Golf Ends Season Early
items.text: LIV Golf canceled the Michigan Team Championship next week and will end its season after 12 events, while Jon Rahm clinched his third consecutive individual season title.

items.headline: Justin Thomas Praises Scheffler
items.text: Justin Thomas highlighted the impressive qualities of world number one Scottie Scheffler, emphasizing his dominance on tour.
